title: Resolve indoor and studio contact misses
description: Use independently reviewed, frame-aligned labels for the indoor three-contact and studio zero-contact windows. Diagnose detector loss, identity drift, pose abstention and contact matching separately. Preserve the lost-ball confirmation safeguard. Report contact precision, recall, timing error and anatomical foot-side accuracy on source/player-disjoint held-out clips. Do not tune correctness thresholds on public imported or implementer labels.

title: Measure identity failures and confirmation burden
description: Extend independent evaluation to one-frame dropouts, continuous lookalikes, camera movement, edge exits and scene cuts. Report wrong detections, visible misses and confirmation interruptions together. Keep calibration and held-out videos, sources and players disjoint. Include night, rain, small/fast balls and full 30-second juggling windows. Run python tools/audit_corpus.py evaluation/corpus.json before claiming calibration readiness.

title: Benchmark full-window speed and cancellation
description: Benchmark original versus normalized 30-second footage. Separate decode, detector and optional pose timings. Exercise cancellation during model load, decode, inference, pose, reseeding and navigation; verify repeat runs do not leak workers or saved partial analyses. Use disposable SDLC app data. Run hosted CI once the repository destination is supplied, then record an actual coach/player usability pilot.
